scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n back,front -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend --omit=dev && npm install --prefix frontend --include=dev && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
